description: backup-get-expired-backups.md and backup-get-repository-info.md both state explicitly that their URIs are 'only available from the Backup Service port (8097 by default) on nodes running the Backup Service.' Yet backup-get-plan-info.md's own second worked example reaches the same kind of endpoint (plan info) through port 8091 via a `_p/backup/` proxy prefix instead of port 8097, and backup-get-repository-info.md's own third example does the identical thing for repository-info. Both access paths to the same endpoints are attested twice each within this one batch, raising confidence this is a real, intentional dual-homing (matching the fan-out pattern already documented for Analytics/Query/Eventing REST APIs through port 8091) rather than a one-off typo - but no page reconciles this with the 'only available from... 8097' framing sentence, or states which access path is canonical.
